name: pg_cron for PostgreSQL 18
summary: pg_cron, cron-style job scheduling inside PostgreSQL, as an extension built with Clang (llvm-mingw); once installed, PostgreSQL's server loads it

modules.name: pg_cron
build: sed -i '/"cron.use_background_workers"/,/PGC_POSTMASTER/ s/^\(\s*\)false,$/\1true,/' src/pg_cron.c && sed -n '/"cron.use_background_workers"/,/PGC_POSTMASTER/p' src/pg_cron.c | grep -q 'true,'

printf '%s\r\n' '@echo off' 'echo This image is pg_cron 1.6.8, for PostgreSQL 18.' 'echo Installed, PostgreSQL'"'"'s server loads it at start: CREATE EXTENSION pg_cron; in the postgres database.' 'echo Its jobs run in background workers: cron.use_background_workers is on.' 'echo zigsaw run --noextension=^<its id^> leaves it out.' > "$PREFIX/about.bat"
